SELECT charge_code, charge_name, sub_period, amount AS origin_amount FROM CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE CBC WHERE
start_date <= DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d') AND expire_date >= DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d') AND amount > 0

SELECT LIST.* FROM ( SELECT ROUND(@ROWNUM := @ROWNUM + 1, 0) AS ROWNUM, CBPD.user_code, CSC.SELECT_NM AS status_name, CBPD.status, DATE_FORMAT(CBPD.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(CBPD.cancel_date,IFNULL(CBPD.change_date,CBPD.expire_date)), '%Y-%m-%d') AS expire_date, CBC.amount AS charge_amount, CBPD.amount AS payment_amount, CBPD.payment_base_amount, CBPD.payment_base_vat, CBPD.charge_code, CBPD.seq, CBPD.pg_id, CBPD.imp_uid, CBPD.payment_date, IFNULL(CBC.charge_name, CBC2.charge_name) AS charge_name, CBC.sub_period, CBC.sub_unit, CPC.promo_name FROM CBCI_BILLING_PAYMENT_DETAIL CBPD LEFT JOIN CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE CBC ON CBPD.charge_code = CBC.charge_code LEFT JOIN CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE CBC2 ON CBPD.ex_charge_code = CBC2.charge_code LEFT JOIN CBCI_PROMOTION_CODE CPC ON CBPD.promotion_code = CPC.promo_code LEFT JOIN CBCI_SELECT_CODE CSC ON CBPD.status = CSC.SELECT_CD, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP WHERE CBPD.user_code = #{user_code} AND CSC.SELECT_CLASS = 'billingUserStatus' AND CBPD.status != 'DSB' ORDER BY CBPD.payment_date) LIST ORDER BY LIST.payment_date DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y년 %m월 %d일') AS standard_date, CBPD.seq, CBC.charge_name, DATE_FORMAT(CBPD.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date, DATE_FORMAT(CBPD.expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expire_date, DATEDIFF(CBPD.expire_date, IF(CBPD.start_date >= now(), CBPD.start_date, now())) AS dateDiff, CPC.promo_name, CBPD.promotion_code, CBPD.amount FROM CBCI_BILLING_PAYMENT_DETAIL CBPD LEFT JOIN CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE CBC ON CBPD.charge_code = CBC.charge_code LEFT JOIN CBCI_PROMOTION_CODE CPC ON CBPD.promotion_code = CPC.promo_code LEFT JOIN CBCI_SELECT_CODE CSC ON CBPD.status = CSC.SELECT_CD WHERE CBPD.user_code = #{user_code} AND CSC.SELECT_CLASS = 'billingUserStatus' AND LEFT(CBPD.status,1) = 'U' AND CBPD.status = 'SB' AND CBPD.status != 'DSB' ORDER BY CBPD.payment_date DESC

SELECT CPC.promo_code, CPC.status, CPC.promo_name, CPC.promo_target, CCPC.charge_code, CPC.partner_code, CPC.discount_rate, CPC.discount_amount, CPC.free_period, CPC.free_period_unit, CPC.sub_id, CPC.promo_detail, DATE_FORMAT(CPC.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as start_date, DATE_FORMAT(CPC.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as end_date, DATE_FORMAT(CPC.input_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as input_date FROM CBCI_PROMOTION_CODE CPC, CBCI_CHARGE_PROMOTION_CONNECTION CCPC WHERE CPC.promo_code = CCPC.promo_code AND CPC.promo_code = #{promotionCode} AND CCPC.charge_code = #{chargeCode} AND CPC.partner_code = #{partner_code}
AND CPC.start_date <= DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d') AND CPC.end_date >= DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%y-%m-%d')
SELECT charge_code, charge_name, sub_period, sub_unit, amount AS origin_amount FROM CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE CBC WHERE charge_code = #{chargeCode}

change_date = #{startDate}, status = IF(#{status} = 'SB', 'DSB', RIGHT(status,2)),
cancel_date = #{startDate},

SELECT COUNT(CBPD.seq) AS COUNT FROM CBCI_BILLING_PAYMENT_DETAIL CBPD WHERE CBPD.payment_date >= DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT CBPD.pg_id, CBPD.imp_uid, DATE_FORMAT(CBR.refund_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS refund_date, CBC.charge_name, DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(CBPD.change_date, CBPD.cancel_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AS change_date, IFNULL(CONCAT(CBR.refund_type, CBR.status), CBPD.status) AS status, CBPD.amount FROM CBCI_BILLING_PAYMENT_DETAIL CBPD LEFT JOIN CBCI_BILLING_REFUND CBR ON CBPD.seq = CBR.new_seq LEFT JOIN CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE CBC ON CBC.charge_code = IF(CBPD.charge_code = 'withdraw',CBPD.ex_charge_code,CBPD.charge_code) WHERE CBPD.seq = #{seq}
